title: Classify C++ GESP questions into domains and review queues
action: Apply existing GESP C++ domain and knowledge heuristics to WanJuanWang questions and output reviewable tags plus review queue items.
implementation: Reuse domain and knowledge seed logic from the current classification pipeline wherever possible.
Treat page-level knowledge labels as low-granularity source metadata and infer concrete candidate knowledge points from question text.
Classify programming questions into existing workbench domain IDs or `unclassified` when no confident mapping exists.
Create review queue outputs for ambiguous domains, missing options, missing samples, image failures and out-of-level/disputed tags such as DP at constrained levels.
verification_notes: Classification file and review queue file are generated.
All 136 programming questions now have at least one algorithm domain.
Built catalog consumes classification output successfully.
